name: frontend-skills
description: React/TypeScript frontend + Go backend enforcement harness. 89 wired hooks across 98 scripts enforce patterns on every edit. 47 skills from TDD through CI-green PR, including /snyk-ux-security per-path vuln sweep (JS + Go ecosystems; exploitability-triage first gate via `bun why`/`go mod why`/`govulncheck`; top-level direct dep bump first, parent dep bump second, resolutions/overrides/replace as last resort only with follow-up TODO to remove; React 18 pin + changelog-walked major bumps + no-deferral escalation; Go `snyk test --file=go.mod` + `go get -u` + `go mod tidy` + `govulncheck` verify). Session exit blocked while PR review threads remain unresolved. TypeScript escape hatches blocked at Edit. tsconfig strictness weakening blocked. Worktree isolation + branch safety hook-enforced. bun.lock + yarn.lock parity enforced (Snyk IO doesn't parse bun.lock). 21 LLM failure modes enforced: 7 Karpathy single-agent + 14 MAST multi-agent (Cemri et al. NeurIPS 2025). OWASP + STRIDE subset + snyk/bun audit. Core Web Vitals perf gate. MCP ban with CLI redirect (~20x token savings). Agent-browser wrap (~91% token reduction for AI browsing). 3-hat plan review (product/engineering/design). 9 agents (adds plan hats + karpathy reference), 5 routines. Opus 4.7 tuned, POSIX-friendly.

x-changelog.4.7.0: 2026-04-22 -- /snyk-ux-security: exploitability-triage first-gate + top-level-first upgrade ladder + Go ecosystem parity. (1) Exploitability triage (new first gate): per finding decide REACHABLE vs NOT-REACHABLE before any bump. Inputs: advisory attack vector, `bun why <pkg>` / `go mod why <mod>`, direct-import grep, usage check vs vulnerable symbol. NOT-REACHABLE -> dismiss via `snyk ignore --id=<id> --reason='<specific why>' --expiry=<ISO date>` and document in PR under `Dismissed (not exploitable)` with CVE + symbol + reason + expiry. Expiry forces re-triage so dismissals do not rot (SLA audit trail). Reachable or credible vector -> proceed. (2) Upgrade priority ladder: 1. Direct dep bump (the package already in our manifest) -- default path. 2. Parent dep bump (the direct dep pulling the vuln transitive) -- second choice. 3. `resolutions` / `overrides` / `replace` only as last resort -- they do not scale, bloat lockfiles, force more overrides next week; each override gets a follow-up TODO to remove once upstream ships a fix, logged in a dedicated `Overrides added` PR section with blocker explanation. Why: node_modules bloat from reflex-adding resolutions when the CVE was never reachable; top-level bumps are upstream-tracked and self-maintaining. (3) Go ecosystem parity (new track alongside JS track): ecosystem detect per path -- `package.json` -> JS, `go.mod` -> Go, both present -> both tracks in same worktree, separate commits, single PR. Scan: `snyk test --file=go.mod` + `snyk monitor --file=go.mod` + `govulncheck -json ./...` (native call-graph reachability verdicts from the Go security team -- prefer its reachability verdict over raw CVE lists). Triage: non-reachable transitives dismissed with reason `govulncheck: not reachable from call graph`. Bump: `go get -u <mod>@<ver>` first, then parent, then `replace` directive last resort (with tracking issue). Sync: `go mod tidy` -- `go.mod` + `go.sum` commit together, never hand-edit. Verify: `go build ./...`, `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `govulncheck ./...` clean for addressed CVEs. PR gets `lang/go` label + backend team inferred from CODEOWNERS (`services/*`, `cmd/*`, paths with `go.mod`). Rule: do NOT bump `go 1.XX` toolchain directive as part of a CVE sweep -- separate change. (4) Docs: SKILL.md rewritten to 75 lines (110-line cap) with triage + ladder + Go track sections; REFERENCE.md gains `Exploitability triage`, `Upgrade priority`, `Go ecosystem notes` sections + expanded PR body template with `Dismissed` + `Overrides added` tables + per-ecosystem verify checklists. (5) Preserved: bun-only JS runtime; React 18 pin + `react19-blocked` skip; dual-lockfile invariant + lockfile-sync-check.sh drift guard; never-defer rule for real reachable vulns; sequential per-path worktree isolation. (6) Evals: +23 checks covering triage, ladder, and Go track (go.mod, govulncheck, go get -u, go mod tidy, go build/test/vet, snyk test --file=go.mod, replace directive last-resort, go.sum, call-graph reachability). Full suite 1819/1819 pass, zero skips.

x-changelog.4.5.0: 2026-04-22 -- New /snyk-ux-security skill + lockfile parity hook + hook-lib payload-diff fix. (1) /snyk-ux-security: per-path Snyk vuln sweep for UX/frontend repos. Paths as args (glob ok); reviewers/labels/UX-assignee/workflow inferred from CODEOWNERS + git history + repo state (no static config). Enforces React 18 pin (React 19 peers skipped + reported). Walks majors incrementally via changelog migrations (7->8->9, one commit per hop). Never defers vulns -- escalates instead. Opens one PR per path with reviewers/labels/description + triggers cloud review workflow. 76-check eval suite. (2) lockfile-sync-check.sh PostToolUse hook enforces bun.lock + yarn.lock parity -- Snyk IO does not parse bun.lock so the yarn.lock mirror must exist. Two signals: git-diff parity + added-package presence parity. Warns on binary bun.lockb (bun >=1.2 ships text bun.lock). Wired into skill-manifest PostToolUse Edit|Write. (3) hook-lib fix: hook_get_added_lines switched from `git diff HEAD` fallback (which `cat`-ed the whole file on untracked or deleted-in-HEAD files, reporting every pre-existing violation as 'new') to payload diff -- Edit uses old_string vs new_string, Write uses `git show HEAD:file` vs payload.content (or full content if untracked). Root fix for noisy false-positives during untracked-file sessions (observed heavily while building /snyk-ux-security on files not yet tracked). (4) New evals/test-hook-payload-diff.sh (6/6) regression-guards the fix. (5) Catches up plugin.json to 4.4.0 entry -- prior release bumped marketplace + codex + manifest but missed .claude-plugin/plugin.json.

x-changelog.4.3.1: 2026-04-20 -- lifecycle-stop UX fix: stop-hook no longer holds sessions hostage on tool-gap conditions. (1) Adjacent-test scan extended to cross-ext (Foo.tsx + Foo.test.ts valid pair, hooks/utils pattern) plus global `git ls-files` basename scan -- catches tests in src/__tests__/, test/, or anywhere in tree from prior sessions. (2) Three block paths downgraded to warn (exit 0 + systemMessage): CI-pending (wait condition), coverage-unavailable (can't verify != test missing), no-vitest (tool gap). The coverage-unavailable block was triggering an infinite /tdd loop -- block -> /tdd writes a test -> coverage tooling still can't verify -> block again. Hard blocks reserved for evidence-based conditions: measured low coverage %, CI failure, uncommitted/unpushed, missing PR, missing reviewer. react-doctor-stop: specific warn-only branch for known incomplete dead-code failure (issues.files not iterable) with tail-20 context. 8 stale-filter evals green (2 new: cross-ext adjacent, non-adjacent basename match).

x-changelog.3.2.0: 2026-04-18 — gstack-inspired hardening. (1) Worktree isolation: new `_hook_file_outside_current_worktree` helper catches sibling-worktree leakage (the old `_hook_in_secondary_worktree` only handled parent-vs-subagent). Session binds to worktree + branch on start; every hook asserts and no-ops on drift. Deterministic md5-based session-id fallback when CLAUDE_SESSION_ID unset. (2) New `branch-safety-check.sh` PreToolUse(Bash) blocks git commit/push/checkout/switch when HEAD drifts from bound branch; `CLAUDE_BRANCH_REBIND=1` escape hatch. (3) Codex cross-model review wired into `code-reviewer` agent — triggers on diff >100 lines or auth/security paths, graceful skip when `codex` CLI absent. (4) Karpathy failure-modes checklist at `agents/karpathy-failure-modes.md` — required reading for all reviewer agents. Each must emit `karpathy_checks` in findings. (5) `adversarial-reviewer` now gated: runs only on diff >200 lines OR prior CRITICAL finding OR auth paths. Emits SKIPPED block otherwise. (6) New skills: `/cso` (OWASP+STRIDE pre-ship audit), `/canary` (15-min post-deploy regression watch), `/benchmark` (Core Web Vitals gate), `/mux` (atomic worktree+branch+session spawn). (7) `ETHOS.md` — 7 permanent principles injected harness-wide. (8) Browser daemon v4.0 RFC at `docs/rfc/browser-daemon.md`. Evals 1464/1464 green (57 new).

x-changelog.3.1.0: 2026-04-17 — PR feedback completeness enforcement + TypeScript strictness hardening. New `pr-feedback-completeness-stop.sh` Stop hook blocks session exit while any non-bot, non-outdated review thread is unresolved or any reviewer's latest state is CHANGES_REQUESTED — no stones unturned before handing back to human. GraphQL isolated in `scripts/pr-unresolved-count.sh` wrapper (GitHub REST has no thread-level isResolved). New `ts-no-escape-hatches-check.sh` PostToolUse hook blocks `: any`, `any[]`, `Array<any>`, `Promise<any>`, `Record<string,any|unknown>`, `Record<any,...>`, `type X = any|unknown|never|{}`, `as unknown as T` double-cast, with `// allow: ts-escape` escape hatch. New `tsconfig-strict-check.sh` blocks weakening of `strict`, `noImplicitAny`, `strictNullChecks`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noImplicitOverride`, `strictFunctionTypes`. Lifecycle-stop gains adjacent-test fallback — tests on disk (prior session, worktree, __tests__/) now satisfy the coverage gate, fixing the worktree/multi-session false-flag. AI self-review cap bumped 2 → 3 rounds with explicit early-exit on APPROVED/empty-findings. Two new eval files (test-pr-feedback-enforcement 29/29, test-ts-strictness 34/34). Eval suite 1387/1387 green. test-hooks.sh set -e pipefail bug fixed.
